findings.description: During stirring, balls far from the stirring hand sit high on the steep far wall of the bowl near the rim (yellow ball at 00:08.25, red ball at 00:07.75 and 00:09.25) with no hand contact and no plausible support, appearing to hover/cling rather than rolling back down under gravity; the stirring hand is at the bowl bottom on the opposite side.

At 00:09.25-00:09.75 the stirring hand's fingertips appear to sink into and merge with red and green balls at the bowl bottom rather than resting on their surfaces; finger outlines dissolve into ball color with no clear contact boundary (partly masked by motion blur).
